label: Оставить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for оставить (to leave behind, to keep).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Оставлю' is the 1sg of perfective оставить; the stem в takes an epenthetic л before the ending. The imperfective partner is оставлять.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Оставишь' shows the -ишь ending of оставить; the л appears only in the 1sg, so it is absent here. 'Мне записку' is dative plus accusative.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Оставит' is the -ит form of оставить, naming a single completed act. 'Машину у дома' fixes where it stays.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Оставим' carries the -им ending of оставить. 'Всё как есть' is a fixed phrase for leaving things unchanged.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Оставите' trains the -ите form of оставить. 'Нам ваш адрес' makes a natural request.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Оставят' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending of оставить. 'Детей у бабушки' names where they will be left.

missions.phrase: Вчера он оставил зонт в такси.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Оставил' is the completed masculine past of оставить with the -л suffix. 'Зонт в такси' describes a single act of leaving behind.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Оставила' adds the feminine -ла ending of оставить. 'Телефон дома' marks one finished oversight.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Оставили' is the plural -ли past of оставить. Contrast this single completed result with the imperfective оставлять.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Оставь' is the command form of оставить. 'В покое' is a fixed idiom; the whole phrase means 'leave me alone'.
